PluginData.Author: CometWorks
PluginData.Tooltip: Conceals distant grids in offline and player-hosted worlds
PluginData.Description: Reduces simulation load by pausing distant grid groups in worlds you host. Supports offline games and friends multiplayer. In a game hosted by Magnetar, the server plugin controls concealment; this client plugin leaves the server in charge. Configure local and hosted worlds through the Pulsar settings dialog.
